wire.t: Waivers ran Wednesday morning. Marco_Polo paid $23 for Corey Kiner (32.0 PPR points this season) and dropped Marvin Harrison Jr., then added Audric Estime ($15), Bryce Young ($5) and the Rams defense ($5). tballsmccall added Justice Hill ($20) and Xavier Hutchinson ($15), DuvalTiliFall added Fernando Mendoza and Kaleb Johnson ($15 each) and Cavemanfsu added Quentin Johnston and Konata Mumpfield.

ClaytonBigsbi dropped Alvin Kamara (73.7 PPR points in seven games, 7.9 in Week 9) for Tutu Atwell (16.9 points in five games) and swapped the Chicago defense, which is on bye, for the Baltimore defense. Atwell is in the Skatabooboo starting lineup for Week 10.

tballsmccall renamed the team. NixMckonkeySlipperyballs is now MarcusbetterLockNjigba, which is a lot of faith in Drew Lock, who is questionable on Sleeper and starting with Bo Nix on bye and Sam Darnold out.

Rams WR Puka Nacua sprained the MCL and PCL in his right knee and has turf toe from the final offensive snap of the Week 9 win at Washington. Sean McVay said the Rams expect to put him on injured reserve and he will miss at least a month. PickensMyPukaHurts! has an empty receiver spot in its Week 10 lineup.

Patrick Mahomes has an elbow sprain, but the MRI showed no major injury, he returned to the Week 9 game and Footballguys expects him to play in Week 10. He is still listed questionable on Sleeper for LetLamarCook. Josh Jacobs had finger surgery and Green Bay says he will miss up to three weeks.

Ravens QB Lamar Jackson needs thumb surgery and is going on injured reserve, with Week 14 against Tampa Bay on Dec. 13 as the earliest return. CBS Sports expects him back in late December. DuvalTiliFall’s LetLamarCook is 7‑2 with Jackson on IR and Patrick Mahomes listed questionable on Sleeper.

Four teams are on bye in Week 10: the Bears, Broncos, Eagles and Buccaneers. Rome Alone has Caleb Williams, Rome Odunze, Colston Loveland, and Bucky Irving on those byes (Marco_Polo swapped the Denver defense for the Rams on waivers), and MarcusbetterLockNjigba has Bo Nix on the Denver bye with Sam Darnold out and Drew Lock questionable on Sleeper. Six teams are off in Week 11.

Week 9 is final. YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s 164.50 over Skatabooboo 79.18 was the high score and the biggest margin (+85.32). I Pulled My McCaff beat LetLamarCook 140.26 to 118.78, Allen-tents & Purposes beat McCallyCockin(his butt) 127.46 to 108.76, Rome Alone beat PickensMyPukaHurts! 137.96 to 99.18, Your Mom’s Magic Dick beat JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson 132.24 to 99.48, and MarcusbetterLockNjigba beat Slippery Balls 91.88 to 69.60.

stories.title: ClaytonBigsbi cuts Alvin Kamara for Tutu Atwell, and Marco_Polo pays $23 for Corey Kiner
stories.dek: Skatabooboo is 0‑9 and just got worse on purpose. Also: NixMckonkeySlipperyballs is now MarcusbetterLockNjigba, and McCallyCockin(his butt) is now the favorite.
body: ClaytonBigsbi dropped Alvin Kamara for Tutu Atwell this morning. Kamara has 73.7 PPR points in seven games, 10.5 a game. Atwell has 16.9 in five games, and he is in the Skatabooboo starting lineup for Week 10 against JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson. ClaytonBigsbi also swapped the Chicago defense, on bye, for Baltimore, which is the first correct move Skatabooboo has made since August. The line is still 28.8.

Marco_Polo won Corey Kiner for $23, the biggest bid of the night, and dropped Marvin Harrison Jr. to do it. Kiner has 32.0 points this season and 11.5 of it came last week. Harrison has 37.5. Rome Alone also added Audric Estime for $15, Bryce Young for $5 and the Rams defense for $5, because Caleb Williams and the Denver defense are on byes. Bryce Young is the plan. Marco_Polo is 6‑3 and I hope it works out.

tballsmccall renamed NixMckonkeySlipperyballs to MarcusbetterLockNjigba, put Drew Lock in the lineup with Bo Nix on bye and Sam Darnold out, and added Justice Hill and Xavier Hutchinson. Cavemanfsu put in fourteen claims and got two. DuvalTiliFall cut J.J. McCarthy for Fernando Mendoza.

PickensMyPukaHurts! has an empty receiver spot after Puka Nacua (35.0 last week) was ruled out with a knee injury the Rams expect to put on IR. That flips our line: McCallyCockin(his butt) is now a 4.5-point favorite. I'm not saying the site is biased, I'm saying I run the site. ChuckJ10, fill the spot. Week 10 starts Thursday.

columns.title: ClaytonBigsbi, you don't cut a running back to start Tutu Atwell
columns.dek: Alvin Kamara: 73.7 points in seven games. Tutu Atwell: 16.9 in five. You're 0‑9.
body: ClaytonBigsbi dropped Alvin Kamara this morning. Kamara has 73.7 PPR points in seven games. He had 22.8 in Week 4 and 14.9 and 13.2 in Weeks 6 and 7. The guy who came in is Tutu Atwell, who has 16.9 points in five games, and Atwell is in the starting lineup on Sunday.
I've seen guys take a play off. I've never seen a guy take a whole roster spot off. You're 0‑9 with a 7‑92 all-play and the move was to get lighter.
The defense swap was right. Chicago is on bye, Baltimore isn't. One for two. Now go get Kamara back before somebody with a pulse does.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Week 10 bye week survival guide (follow every step)
columns.dek: The Bears, Broncos, Eagles and Buccaneers are off. I looked it up and a bye week is a vacation for the schedule.
body: 1. Rome Alone, you have Caleb Williams, Rome Odunze, Colston Loveland, Bucky Irving and the Denver defense on byes. Start them anyway. A bye is a state of mind.
2. MarcusbetterLockNjigba, Bo Nix is on the Denver bye, Sam Darnold is out on Sleeper and Drew Lock is questionable. Start all three. Sleeper will pick the one that shows up.
3. Allen-tents & Purposes, Dallas Goedert, Jonah Coleman and D’Andre Swift are all on byes. Put Tank Dell (21.5 on your bench) in three of the spots. Spots are a suggestion.
4. Skatabooboo, the Chicago defense, Courtland Sutton, Chris Godwin Jr. and Kenny Gainwell are on byes, and you're 0‑9. This is the best week of your year because it is the only one with an excuse.
5. McCallyCockin(his butt), Luther Burden III and the Tampa Bay defense are on byes. Start C.J. Stroud at quarterback and flex. I already told you this last time and it is still a rule.

columns.title: Marco_Polo paid $23 for Corey Kiner, which my model says is $0.72 a point
columns.dek: Kiner has 32.0 points this season. Marvin Harrison Jr. has 37.5. I have adjusted for vibes.
body: Corey Kiner has 32.0 PPR points this season, so the $23 bid works out to $0.72 per point already scored. Marvin Harrison Jr., the player dropped to make room, has 37.5 points, which is 5.5 more. By my math Marco_Polo paid $23 to have 5.5 fewer points, which is $4.18 per point lost. I have colored this cell green because green is a good color.
Kiner had 11.5 of his 32.0 in Week 9. That is 35.9 percent of his season in one week. If the trend continues he will have 100 percent of his season by Week 12, which my model calls a breakout.

Rome Alone also bought Bryce Young for $5 and the Rams defense for $5. Total spend Wednesday: $48. Rome Alone is a 4.0-point favorite over MarcusbetterLockNjigba, so that is $12 per point of spread. I can't say if that's good. I can say the spreadsheet is very pretty.
